question: A and B can complete a work in 8 days. B alone can do it in 12 days. In how many days will A alone complete the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM of 8 and 12 = 24 units

Combined Efficiency (A + B) = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of A = Combined Eff − Eff of B = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/day

Time for A alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of A = 24 ÷ 1 = 24 days

**∴ Answer = 24 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 8 days

Time taken by B alone = 12 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of all given days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Number of Days

Efficiency of A = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of B = 3 − 2 = 1

 
Time taken by A = 24 ÷ 1 = 24 days

**Calculations:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 8 and 12.

⇒ Total Work = 24 units

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B) = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of A = (A + B) Efficiency − B Efficiency

⇒ Efficiency of A = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time taken by A = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of A = 24 ÷ 1 = 24 days

**∴ The correct answer is 24 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Work Formula

If A can do a work in x days and B can do it in y days, then together they can do it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Individual Work from Combined Work

If A and B together take T days and B alone takes y days, then A alone takes (T × y) ÷ (y − T) days.

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If the ratio of time taken is a:b, then the ratio of efficiency is b:a.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed based on the work done by each person, which is proportional to their respective efficiencies if they work for the same duration.
